requirements.title: Claim status aggregation is centralized in claim status service
requirements.statement: Status aggregation is strictly mediated by update_claim_processing_status in app.services.claim_status. The derive_processing_status helper evaluates all documents associated with a Claim.id to determine the aggregate claim status and populate action_required diagnostics when blocking document states exist.

requirements.title: Adopt two-phase asynchronous ingestion architecture
requirements.statement: The system uses a two-phase ingestion architecture where file upload and persistence occur first, and document extraction is executed asynchronously in the background. Database state transitions are deterministic and govern processing lifecycle.
